thread:
aisha: Heads-up — LyraRetail (enterprise, seat-based) showing a sharp usage drop this week. Renewal ~6w out. New ML lead started last week, procurement pinged earlier today. Can we triage?

 tom: Noted. I pulled the product dashboard, looks like DAU -> ~12 from ~120 last month. Drop starts 3 days after their integration PR.

 analytics-bot: quick query result:
```
weekly_active_users: 12
weekly_active_users_prev_month: 118
most_active_routes: /embed, /chat
avg_latency_30d: 210ms
```

 aisha: thanks — key points: new ML lead (external hire), they started a short pilot with a competitor (StellarAI) according to procurement notes, and dev team raised a reliability bug earlier this sprint.

 rebecca: ok can we list immediate risks and proposed mitigations? I want a one-pager before the CSM+AE call.

 tom: risks: 1) Stakeholder swap (new ML lead prioritizing competitor features). 2) Integration reliability + missing autoscaling knobs => dev choosing alternative. 3) Seat utilization low => procurement may push renewal.

 jules: mitigations: quick reliability triage (eng-oncall), offer a 2-week dedicated performance trial (Dedicated) to match competitor SLA, enable a 30m enablement for their ML lead focused on batching/cost savings.

 aisha: can eng-oncall validate the reported bug? I have the stack trace from their ticket: `error: kvcache OOM at T=2026-03-18 14:02` — they mentioned long tail latency spikes after long chats.

 tom: assigning to eng-sre for triage. Also suggest we surface quantization/latency report and cost delta vs competitor. If we can show 20-30% lower per-token cost in their workload, procurement may pause pilot.

 rebecca: assemble one-pager: overview + action items + proposed timeline. I'll draft. Need: short perf numbers, seat usage heatmap, suggested enablement agenda.

 aisha: I can get usage heatmap and contact info for the new ML lead (A. Chen). Will flag that StellarAI pilot is limited to reranking only per procurement note.

 jules: I'll own the outreach and book a 30m sync this week (will include AE + CSM + new ML lead). Also will offer the Dedicated trial as a follow-up if the sync shows infra concerns.

 tom: quick ask to analytics-bot — can you export last 30 days of route-level calls and cost estimate for their avg seq length? Need by EOD.

 analytics-bot: exporting now — will post CSV link when ready.

 rebecca: nice. aisha/jules — once one-pager is ready, I'll join the call and lead renewal play. Let's keep it concise: data, proposed trial, next steps.

 aisha: agreed. I'll post heatmap + user list here when ready. Thanks team :thumbsup:
